name: Lore
description: Lore is Epic Games' open-source, centralized, self-hostable version control server. Teams push to, clone from, and resolve conflicts through the loreserver endpoint over QUIC and gRPC, backed by durable local-disk storage.

notes.text: Authentication is off, so anyone who reaches port 41337 can connect. Set up JWT verification under [server.auth.jwk] in /opt/lore/local.toml before exposing it.
Developers connect with the lore client CLI on port 41337 (TCP and UDP) and must trust the self-signed certificate in /etc/ssl/lore.
Lore is pre-1.0, so its on-disk format may still change between versions.
